new_jobs.jd: **About The Role And Team** Over the past five years, Uber Eats has captured the hearts of customers across Taiwan, growing from a service in Taipei to an island\-wide movement. We've gone from delivering delicious food to providing essential daily goods. This explosive growth is a testament to our team's talent and dedication. We thrive on challenges and believe that tackling them together makes the journey even more rewarding. Our team operates with a \#GoGetIt attitude, a mindset that defines the spirit of Uber Delivery. Merchants are the backbone of our business. From beloved global chains to local mom\-and\-pop shops, they create the vibrant food culture that has made Uber Eats Taiwan one of our most successful markets globally. This role is at the heart of our strategy, sales, and operations for merchants. Uber Eats is looking to grow the Merchant Growth team in Taiwan. As the **Merchant Operations Manager for Affordability** , you will play a pivotal role in leading and driving Taiwan's marketplace competitiveness and affordability strategy. This workstream sits at a high\-stakes intersection of merchant revenue, consumer offerings, and P\&L governance, requiring a sharp blend of strategic thinking, commercial acumen, and real accountability. This is a highly visible role dealing with high stakeholder complexity across local Account Management, Consumer Operations, Commercial Operations, Finance, Legal, and Global/Regional Product teams. If you thrive in ambiguous environments, enjoy building strategic frameworks from scratch rather than just executing existing playbooks, and want to exercise serious commercial muscle, this role provides an exceptional platform for impact. You will champion critical platform affordability initiatives\-such as managing menu price inflation and executing In\-Store Price (ISP) strategies, to maintain a healthy, thriving marketplace for our partners and consumers. **What You'll Do** * Own Affordability \& Competitiveness Strategy: Drive Taiwan's overarching affordability framework. Build, overhaul, and maintain central performance tracking dashboards, ensuring local structures scale cleanly and align with Global reporting standards. * Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Sales Enablement: Partner deeply with local Account Management teams to build commercial frameworks, synthesize merchant sentiments, and arm internal teams with the playbooks and resources required to unlock merchant growth. **Basic Qualifications** * Minimum of 4 years of professional experience in operations, product management, corporate strategy, or data analytics, ideally within eCommerce, marketplace apps, tech, or fast\-paced corporate environments. * Analytical \& Modeling Skills: Advanced analytical capabilities with a proven track record of handling complex data. new_jobs.jd: 委託客戶為 **台灣大型食品供應鏈與餐飲服務事業公司** ，協助餐飲集團在餐飲營運、食品研發、中央廚房、生產製造、品質管理、採購及物流配送等核心能力，提供高度標準化且具規模化的食品供應鏈服務。 除支援餐飲集團內部餐飲品牌外，公司亦積極發展 **B2B 餐飲供應鏈及食品服務市場** ，針對連鎖餐飲、零售通路及大型企業客戶，提供從產品共同開發、原物料採購、食品加工、半成品／調理食品生產、品質控管，到冷鏈物流配送等一站式解決方案。 例如依據連鎖餐飲客戶需求，將肉品、醬料、湯底、調理包或其他食材於中央廚房完成前段加工與標準化處理，再配送至全台各門市，由門市進行最後階段烹調、組裝或加工後直接銷售，以協助客戶降低門市人力需求、提高產品一致性並提升營運效率。 因應 B2B 事業快速成長，公司現正尋找具備 **大型連鎖餐飲客戶服務及食品供應鏈事業經營經驗** 的高階主管，帶領公司進一步拓展外部市場及建立具規模化的餐飲供應鏈服務平台。 **人才需求條件:** * 具 15 年以上食品、餐飲供應鏈、Food Service、食品製造或相關產業經驗，並具高階主管或大型事業單位管理經驗。 * 必須具備 B2B 服務大型連鎖餐飲企業之實際經驗。 * 曾負責以下其中數項完整服務流程： + 客戶菜單／產品需求分析 + 食品或半成品共同開發 + 中央廚房／食品工廠生產 + 食材前處理及標準化 + 調理食品／Ready\-to\-Cook / Ready\-to\-Heat 產品 + 冷鏈物流及多門市配送 + 大型連鎖餐飲 Key Account Management * 熟悉「中央生產、門市最後加工」之餐飲供應模式，例如由食品工廠完成切割、醃製、調味、預煮、醬料或湯底製作，再配送至餐飲門市進行最後烹調及銷售。 * 具大型客戶 Business Development、Commercial Negotiation 及 Contract Management 經驗。 * 具 P\&L Management 經驗，能同時掌握營收成長、毛利率、成本及營運效率。 * 具跨功能團隊管理能力，能有效整合 Sales、R\&D、Production、QA、SCM、Procurement 及 Logistics。 **具以下公司／產業背景者尤佳：** * Food Service / 食品服務商 * 大型食品製造及加工企業 * 中央廚房／團膳／餐飲供應鏈企業 * 肉品、水產、調理食品或冷凍食品加工企業 * 醬料、湯底及餐飲原物料供應商 * 曾承接大型連鎖餐飲品牌 OEM / ODM / Contract Manufacturing 業務之企業 * 具全台多據點、冷鏈物流及門市配送服務經驗之食品供應商 **工作內容:** **B2B 事業策略與營運管理** * 負責公司 B2B 餐飲食品服務事業之整體營運與成長策略，包含營收、獲利、組織及中長期事業發展。 * 制定連鎖餐飲、零售及大型企業客戶之市場開發策略，建立具規模性的商業模式。 * 管理事業 P\&L，持續改善毛利、成本結構、生產效率與營運績效。 **Key Account Development \& Solution Selling** * 開發及經營大型連鎖餐飲集團、餐飲品牌及策略客戶。 * 深入了解客戶菜單、門市營運及供應鏈需求，提供客製化 Food Solution。 * 將客戶原本於門市進行的備料、加工或烹調流程，轉化為可由中央工廠／中央廚房完成之標準化半成品或調理食品。 * 與客戶共同進行新品開發、配方設計、規格制定、成本分析及量產導入。 * 建立長期 Strategic Partnership，而非單純產品銷售關係。 **食品供應鏈與營運整合** * 整合業務、R\&D、採購、生產、品保、物流及供應鏈等跨部門資源。 * 確保產品由開發、試產、量產至門市配送皆符合客戶品質、成本及交期要求。 * 建立可複製、可擴張的中央廚房／食品加工及門市供應模式。 * 持續優化 Forecast、產能、生產排程、庫存、物流及冷鏈配送效率。 **組織與團隊領導** * 帶領業務、產品開發及營運相關團隊，建立績效管理及人才梯隊。 * 建立具市場導向及客戶導向的組織文化。 * 作為公司高階管理團隊成員，參與公司整體策略規劃及重大投資與營運決策。

Today we operate three core products, ContactLoop (multi\-channel marketing), VoiceFusion (Voice AI engine), and RemoteHunter (remote talent platform) with several new product lines on the way. As we scale, we're adding a Product Manager to own product discovery, translate customer needs into clear direction, and drive cross\-functional coordination across our growing portfolio. Partnered with our Staff Engineer who leads technical execution, you'll have the room to focus on what matters most: making sure every product decision is driven by real customer value. **Job Description:** We're looking for a Product Manager to partner closely with our Staff Engineer / TPM and lead product direction, customer\-needs translation, and zero\-to\-one new product launches. You'll own what to build and why, while your engineering counterparts own technical execution. The ideal candidate is fluent in English, sharp under pressure, and instinctively skeptical of AI demos that look "95% there." You're a daily user of AI tools, comfortable in a US\-style work environment, and able to operate across time zones, products, and stakeholders without losing the thread. **Key Responsibilities:** * Identify what customers actually need, from interviews, support logs, usage data, and stakeholder feedback. Not just collecting requests, but judging what's worth doing. * Define what "good" means for AI products, quality bar, escalation triggers, human\-in\-the\-loop boundaries. Logic over detail. * Own one new product line from zero to one, discovery, MVP, launch, and iteration. * Act as the cross\-functional hub between Taiwan engineering, overseas colleagues, and customers, keeping things moving across multiple time zones, products, and stakeholders. * Communicate product decisions clearly, to leadership, engineering, and overseas counterparts in their own language and style. * Stay current with AI capabilities, judging what's feasible now vs. worth waiting for the next model. * Absorb light program\-management work as needed, given the multi\-time\-zone, multi\-product nature of the role. **Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree (any field). * 2\+ years of relevant experience, B2B product, UX research, customer\-facing Product Owner, or consulting backgrounds all welcome. * Fluent English (written \+ spoken), can run daily syncs with non\-Chinese\-speaking colleagues and write clear, structured, conclusion\-first documents (no buried lead, no anti\-climax). * Cross\-cultural collaboration experience across multiple time zones, comfortable in a US\-style work environment. * Quick under pressure, calm in chaos, can decide next steps with incomplete information. * Flexible communicator, adapts style for different audiences (leadership, engineering, overseas colleagues, customers) and gets people and things moving. * Sensitive to AI product quality, sees an AI demo and instinctively asks "what about the remaining 5%?" rather than being impressed by the 95%. * Daily user of AI tools (Claude / ChatGPT / Cursor / Notion AI), occasional use is not enough for this role. * Self\-directed, knows what to do next without being told and fills gaps proactively. **Bonus \& Plus:** * Overseas (US / Europe) work or living experience. * Background in Voice AI, Conversational AI, MarTech, or Sales Tech. * Hands\-on with AI prototyping tools (Claude Code, v0, Cursor), able to independently build simple prototypes. * Has previously defined evaluation criteria or success metrics for AI products. **Ideal Traits:** * Thrives in a fast\-paced, "just do things" startup environment. * Comfortable navigating ambiguity and bringing structure where processes are still evolving. * Curious and self\-driven, with a willingness to learn and adapt quickly. * Collaborative and respectful communicator, building positive relationships with engineering, leadership, and customers.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager Senior
new_jobs.jd: **Overview** At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges. Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve. You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward\-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally. Come make an impact every day at Zebra. **What We're Looking For** Are you passionate about bringing groundbreaking technology to a global market? As a Senior Program Manager, you will be the central driver behind the successful launch of Zebra’s next\-generation products and services. This isn't just about managing schedules and budgets; it's about owning the program from concept to launch, navigating complex challenges, and leading diverse, cross\-functional teams to a shared victory. You will be ensuring our most innovative ideas become successful realities. **Essential Duties And Responsibilities** * End\-to\-End Program Ownership: Drive the successful planning, execution, and delivery of moderate to large\-scope product and service launches. Independently build, adapt, and own the master Project Plan from initiation through market transition. * Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Influence: Rally and align cross\-functional teams—including Product Management, Engineering, Marketing, Service/Support, and Operations—to ensure programs stay on schedule and within budget constraints. * Technical Supply Chain \& Manufacturing Interface: Act as the primary technical supply chain interface for external manufacturing partners. Coordinate end\-to\-end partner readiness from early prototyping through successful mass production, actively mitigating supply chain disruptions during critical ramp\-up phases. * Proactive Risk \& Obstacle Management: Anticipate potential program bottlenecks, supply chain constraints, or delays. Independently engage resources and adjust plans to resolve moderate to high\-severity issues, escalating complex problems only when necessary. * Executive Communication \& Alignment: Synthesize complex updates from multi\-disciplinary teams into concise, tailored status reports for senior management. Secure milestone alignment and sign\-off from key business leaders before moving programs forward. * Strategic Decision Making: Balance project scope, schedule, and budget trade\-offs to minimize business impact. Maintain personal accountability for delivering the program against established business objectives. * Mentorship \& Best Practices: Share expertise in PMI PMBOK methodologies and project tools (scheduling, staffing, dependency planning, risk mitigation). Serve as an informal coach and escalation point for Level 1 and Level 2 Program Managers. **Job Requirements** * Education: Bachelors degree * Work Experience: 5\+ years **Key Skills And Competencies** * Executive Communication \& Facilitation: Exceptional communication, meeting facilitation, and presentation skills, with a proven ability to confidently influence and align mid\- to senior\-level cross\-functional audiences. Formal training is preferred. * Advanced Program Management Mastery: Strong working knowledge of advanced program management concepts, methodologies, and frameworks. PMP certification is highly preferred. * Technical Acumen: Deep working knowledge and hands\-on experience within a relevant technical domain (e.g., Hardware, Software, Services, or Supply Chain/Manufacturing). * Project Controls \& Tool Proficiency: Advanced proficiency with PC\-based planning, scheduling, and documentation tools, specifically MS Project and the MS Office Suite, to manage complex task dependencies, risk plans, and resource allocations. * Execution \& Indirect Delegation: Demonstrated strength in cross\-functional delegation, tracking progress, and structured follow\-up to ensure milestone delivery without direct line\-management authority **Benefits** We understand the importance of work\-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well\-being day to promote revitalization and success. **Job Posting Statement** To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e\-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department. **AI Technology Statement** Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job\-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy.

new_jobs.title: Staff Silicon Product Engineer
new_jobs.jd: Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self\-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride\-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider\-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15\+ U.S. states. Waymo's Compute Team is tasked with a critical and exciting mission: We deliver the compute platform responsible for running the fully autonomous vehicle’s software stack. To achieve our mission, we architect and create high\-performance custom silicon; we develop system\-level compute architectures that push the boundaries of performance, power, and latency; and we collaborate closely with many other teammates to ensure we design and optimize hardware and software for maximum performance. We are a multidisciplinary team seeking curious and talented teammates to work on one of the world’s highest performance automotive compute platforms. *This role follows a hybrid work schedule and reports to the Director, Silicon.* **You Will** * Lead Custom Silicon Productization: Drive advanced ASICs and domain\-specific architectures (TPU, ISP, AI/ML compute) for the Waymo Driver from first\-silicon bring\-up through characterization and high\-volume production ramp. * Define System\-Level Test (SLT) Content \& Hardware Strategy: Develop targeted test workloads, stress conditions, and pass/fail criteria and the define and architect the production screening hardware to rigorously screen marginal silicon and system interactions. * Lead RMA \& Field Failure Investigations: Drive comprehensive root\-cause analysis for field returns and RMAs by correlating failure signatures with system telemetry, manufacturing history, and lab data to continuously improve ASIC reliability and close screening and validation gaps. * Execute Hands\-On Debug \& Production Readiness: Perform hands\-on silicon debug using lab equipment, system logs, firmware/software traces, and schematics to develop product operating limits, guard bands, binning strategies, and screening criteria based on characterization results. * Optimize Yield \& Product Health: Develop large\-scale data mining and statistical analysis to identify failure signatures and yield limiters, translating hardware insights into actionable design feedback and scalable screening improvements. * Silicon Bring\-Up and Product Characterization: Partner closely with architecture, validation, platform, operations, and supplier teams to correlate lab, manufacturing, and system telemetry data, and root\-cause silicon and system\-level issues. **You Have** * Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related technical discipline. * 10\+ years of experience in product engineering, silicon bring\-up, silicon characterization, yield debug, system validation, failure analysis, or productization of SoC, ASIC, or other complex semiconductor products, including hands\-on experience bringing up and characterizing complex silicon products from engineering samples through production release. * Experience defining or deploying system\-level test, platform\-level validation, production screening, or workload\-based stress testing; Experience with yield analysis, failure signature analysis, margin analysis, guardbanding, correlation analysis, RMA analysis, or production\-quality improvement. * Experience debugging silicon or system\-level failures using characterization data, system logs, lab measurements, firmware/software traces, schematics, and manufacturing data; Ability to read and interpret schematics, silicon specifications, characterization reports, system logs, and production data. * Proficiency with Python, SQL, JMP, R, MATLAB, or equivalent tools for data analysis, automation, visualization, and debug. **We Prefer** * Experience with AI/ML accelerators, TPUs, GPUs, NPUs, ISPs, high\-performance SoCs, automotive silicon, or domain\-specific architectures. * Experience debugging interactions across silicon, board, firmware, driver, operating system, workload, and application layers including with OS kernel, drivers, BIOS, firmware, boot flows, telemetry, diagnostics, or low\-level software debug. * Strong knowledge of PCIe, Ethernet, MIPI, high\-speed interfaces, power delivery, clocking, reset, thermal behavior, or system performance optimization. * Experience working with foundries, OSATs, contract manufacturers, reliability labs, and external suppliers. * Experience applying machine learning, LLMs, RAG, agent frameworks, or advanced analytics to automate silicon characterization, yield debug, system log analysis, or production health monitoring. Self\-motivated and results\-oriented, with strong ownership of technical deliverables in a fast\-paced development environment; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues to cross\-functional teams and leadership. **Travel Requirements** * Approximately 10% travel, Vendor sites in Taiwan, Bring\-up Activities in California The expected base salary range for this full\-time position is listed below.
